<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **6** documentable anchor(s).

**26** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7181101a536b56dfa3004e91eb9811d1a1c5e34c`.

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **45** of **222** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **177** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`

Coarse fallback — **127** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7181101a536b56dfa3004e91eb9811d1a1c5e34c` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `4b2a2072c1d748aeef4614e0bc3c6081999dad7f` — the merge of head `2bed67490cdf8d6ad363daa404d08beb698f7ce3` into base `7181101a536b56dfa3004e91eb9811d1a1c5e34c`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 4b2a2072c1d748aeef4614e0bc3c6081999dad7f && git checkout 4b2a2072c1d748aeef4614e0bc3c6081999dad7f
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 7181101a536b56dfa3004e91eb9811d1a1c5e34c 2bed67490cdf8d6ad363daa404d08beb698f7ce3 && git checkout -B drift-repro 7181101a536b56dfa3004e91eb9811d1a1c5e34c && git merge --no-ff 2bed67490cdf8d6ad363daa404d08beb698f7ce3

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 7181101a536b56dfa3004e91eb9811d1a1c5e34c
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 7181101a536b56dfa3004e91eb9811d1a1c5e34c` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.
